Half of a Roman multiple motif hook and eye bracelet dating to 250-410AD. This is the hook half of the bracelet. The decoration consists of 5 inscribed lines across the width of the bracelet adjacent to the hook, then a line inscribed along the length of the bracelet with opposing angled lines inscribed from the central line to the edge.
